title: Spectate subscribe frame (spectator -> server, inbound, first frame)
description: The first frame a spectator sends on the broadcast channel (wss .../v1/spectate). Binds this connection to ONE live match and starts the public broadcast stream. The broadcast is PUBLIC: a token is NOT required (spectate-first onboarding, experience-bible §3.8). A `spectate:read` token MAY be supplied to raise this connection's rate/fan-out limits and enable attribution; if supplied and invalid the socket closes 4401. On success the server replies `spectate_ack` then streams `spectator_frame`s. On failure (no such live match, capacity) it replies `spectate_reject` then closes. This channel is READ-ONLY: it never carries or accepts game actions, and it never delivers fog-protected per-player state — only the always-public board god-view (grid-tactics §7.4, §9) plus sanitized, >=3-tick-DELAYED thoughts.

match_id.description: The live match to watch. Discover live matches at GET /v1/matches?status=live.

token.description: OPTIONAL at+jwt carrying the spectate:read scope. The public broadcast needs none; when present it is verified (JWKS) and raises this connection's per-IP rate/fan-out limits and enables attribution. An invalid supplied token closes the socket 4401.

since_seq.description: OPTIONAL resume cursor for reconnects: the last spectator_frame.seq this client rendered. The server resumes by sending the current full frame (seq > since_seq); frames are full snapshots, so no gap-fill is needed. Absent = start from the current full frame.

include.description: OPTIONAL projection of the OPTIONAL streams to include, for thin/data-only feeds. Default: all. The core public state (board, objectives, scoreboard, collapse) is ALWAYS present and cannot be excluded.
